title: CharacterBody2D does not report slide collisions when colliding with RigidBody2D from above
body:
### Tested versions

4.7-beta3, 4.6.1.stable, Godot v4.5.2

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 4 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K (28 threads) - 31.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

CharacterBody2D does not report a slide collision with a RigidBody2D when the RigidBody2D is dropped from "above" (2D platformer style).  The RigidBody2D reports a collision with the CharacterBody2D.

I expect that the CharacterBody2D should report collisions with RigidBody2D regardless of where it's hit or what it's currently colliding with.  It seems that it is something to do with what the CharacterBody2D is already colliding with- for ex, if the CB is colliding with the floor before it is hit by the RB, it does not report the collision.  But if the CB is not currently colliding with anything, the collision with the RB will report correctly.  

### Steps to reproduce

Run the attached project, as setup the CharacterBody2D is not reporting the collision with the RigidBody2D dropped from above. Comment out the gravity application and the CharacterBody2D will report a collision with the RigidBody2D before being moved into the floor by the physics solver.  

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[rb-cb-col-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28317191/rb-cb-col-test.zip)
